strategic_recommendations: Maintain 3-4 posts per week, balancing carousels for reach/saves and story sequences for conversions.
Focus Slide 1 design on high readability (large headline, high-contrast background).
Include direct lead-magnet CTAs in at least 30% of story sequences.
